headlines.title: 上海航交所：运输市场总体平稳 远洋航线走势分化
headlines.summary: 据上海航交所，本周，中国出口集装箱运输市场总体平稳，不同航线市场运价走势出现分化，综合指数上涨。据国家统计局公布的数据显示，中国7月制造业PMI降至49.2，景气水平环比有所回落，但装备制造业和高技术制造业PMI分别为51.4和53.3，保持较快扩张，带动制造业发展向新向优。7月31日，上海航运交易研究所发布的上海出口集装箱综合运价指数为3205.97点，较上期上涨4.7%。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Shipping Exchange: Overall transport market stable, long-haul routes diverge
headlines.summary_en: According to the Shanghai Shipping Exchange, China's export container shipping market remained broadly stable this week, with diverging freight trends across routes and a rise in the composite index. Data from the National Bureau of Statistics shows China's July manufacturing PMI fell to 49.2, with the景气 level declining month-on-month, but the PMI for equipment manufacturing and high-tech manufacturing stood at 51.4 and 53.3 respectively, maintaining rapid expansion and driving the manufacturing sector toward new and higher-quality development. On July 31, the Shanghai Export Containerized Freight Index published by the Shanghai Shipping Exchange Research Institute stood at 3205.97 points, up 4.7% from the previous period.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国负债率下降，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 新报告显示，中国第二季度债务与GDP之比自2022年以来首次下降，尽管政府持续借贷，而家庭和私营企业在房价下跌、收入增长乏力和利润空间收窄的压力下缩减支出。该比率下降1.1个百分点至308.2%。

headlines.summary:
Beijing has pledged to step up macro policy support and enhance the resilience of capital markets for the remainder of the year, sending signals to stablise growth amid a recent slowdown in economic activity and rising volatility in global markets.

headlines.summary_zh: 北京承诺在今年剩余时间加大宏观政策支持力度并增强资本市场韧性，在近期经济活动放缓及全球市场波动加剧之际，发出稳定增长的信号。在由习近平领导的中共中央政治局21人会议结束后，这一信号得以释放。

headlines.title: 美日近30年来首次联手买入日元，美财长备忘录被曝拟买50-100亿美元
headlines.summary: 路透社拍摄的一张照片显示，美国财长贝森特于当地时间周五在戴维营参加特朗普总统内阁会议时，其记事本上的一份“待办事项”清单被曝光，上面写着“买入日元50-100亿美元”。照片拍摄于会议对媒体开放的环节，时间为美东时间上午11点33分（北京时间23点33分）。贝森特的名牌恰好位于记事本上方，清晰可辨。美国财政部发言人未就记事本内容及周五是否已采取干预措施回应置评请求。另据英国金融时报报道，美国财政部于当地时间周五干预了日元汇率，标志着美日近30年来首次联手通过直接购买操作来支持日元。三位知情人士透露，纽约联储代表财政部执行了一项非同寻常的操作——出售欧元以买

headlines.title_en: US and Japan jointly intervene in yen for first time in nearly 30 years; US Treasury Secretary memo reportedly plans to buy $5-10 billion
headlines.summary_en: A photo taken by Reuters shows U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent attending a cabinet meeting with President Trump at Camp David on Friday, with a to-do list on his notepad exposed, reading 'Buy yen $5-10 billion'. The photo was taken during the open-to-media portion of the meeting at 11:33 a.m. ET (11:33 p.m. Beijing time). Bessent's nameplate was clearly visible above the notepad. headlines.title: 哥伦比亚比索创七年新高，央行将积累外汇储备以引导汇率回落
headlines.summary: 哥伦比亚启动了一项旨在积累高达40亿美元国际储备的计划，以促使该国货币从七年高点回落。7月31日，该国央行行长Leonardo Villar宣布了这项决定，就在政策制定者刚刚决定维持利率不变之后。该计划将从8月份初期开始通过每月的看跌期权拍卖进行，首次拍卖的上限为4亿美元。

headlines.title_en: Colombian peso hits seven-year high; central bank to accumulate forex reserves to guide exchange rate lower
headlines.summary_en: Colombia launched a program aimed at accumulating up to $4 billion in international reserves to pull its currency back from seven-year highs. On July 31, central bank governor Leonardo Villar announced the decision, just after policymakers decided to hold interest rates steady. The program will begin in early August through monthly put option auctions, with an initial cap of $400 million.

headlines.title: China’s manufacturing sector falters in July as growth momentum cools
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity has slipped into contraction in July, ending a four-month growth streak as weaker new orders and persistent demand challenges highlight the need for further policy support from Beijing, analysts said.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July, down from 50.3 in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Friday. The reading fell short of the 50.11 projection from economists polled by the financial data...
headlines.title_zh: 中国制造业7月动能降温，增长势头放缓
headlines.summary_zh: 分析师表示，中国7月工厂活动陷入收缩，结束了连续四个月的增长态势，新订单疲软和持续的需求挑战凸显出北京方面需要进一步加大政策支持力度。数据显示，7月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）从6月的50.3降至49.2。

Q: On July 31 ET, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security announced adding over 40 Chinese entities to the 'Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act' entity list. What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. The U.S. actions are groundless, persistently imposing unilateral sanctions on Chinese companies under the guise of so-called 'human rights' and 'forced labor' using domestic law, which is typical economic coercion. These measures seriously harm the legitimate rights and interests of affected companies and severely disrupt global supply chain stability. It must be emphasized that on July 30, Chinese and U.S. trade leads held a video call, conducting candid, in-depth, and constructive exchanges on maintaining stable trade relations. headlines.title_en: ETF funds saw net outflow of 23.707 billion yuan yesterday; July ETF funds saw net inflow of 493.747 billion yuan overall

headlines.summary:

headlines.title_zh: 中国家庭转向现金和谨慎的股票押注，房地产投资渠道收窄
headlines.summary_zh: 中国家庭正迅速撤离房地产，许多人手握大量现金，如今谨慎权衡股票投资，这与韩国形成鲜明对比——韩国散户投资者正积极利用杠杆推动国内外股票押注。房地产在家庭资产中的占比在20年第一季度降至52%。

headlines.title: 53.2万亿元，香港人民币清算量创纪录，离岸市场功能加速升级
headlines.summary: 香港离岸人民币市场正在迎来新变化。数据显示，香港6月人民币清算量升至53.2万亿元，创历史纪录，在港结算规模首次超过港元和美元。此外，香港离岸人民币存款于5月底达到1.13万亿元历史高位，人民币债券发行量年内同比增长33%。多位受访专家认为，清算量、存款和债券发行同步增长，意味着香港离岸人民币市场功能正在从贸易结算进一步向融资、投资和资产配置延伸。人民币国际化也正从“使用场景扩大”，逐步走向“金融功能增强”。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: 53.2 trillion yuan: Hong Kong's renminbi settlement volume hits record, offshore market functions accelerate upgrade
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong's offshore renminbi market is undergoing new changes. Data shows that Hong Kong's June RMB clearing volume rose to 53.2 trillion yuan, a record high, with settlement scale in the city surpassing HK dollar and US dollar for the first time. Additionally, Hong Kong's offshore RMB deposits reached a record 1.13 trillion yuan by end-May, and RMB bond issuance rose 33% year-on-year. Multiple experts surveyed believe that the simultaneous growth in clearing volume, deposits, and bond issuance indicates that Hong Kong's offshore RMB market function is extending from trade settlement to financing, investment, and asset allocation. RMB internationalization is also transitioning from 'expanding usage scenarios' to 'enhancing financial functions.' (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 2025年地方养老基金投资收益率为5.76%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月1日讯，全国社会保障基金理事会今天（1日）发布报告，2025年地方养老基金投资收益额1420.71亿元，投资收益率5.76%。自2016年12月受托运营以来，地方养老基金累计投资收益额5544.30亿元，年均投资收益率5.14%，超过年均保底收益率2.63%约2.51个百分点。报告指出，社保基金会坚持并持续丰富“长期投资、价值投资、责任投资”理念，审慎稳健开展投资运营管理，忠实履行好基金安全和保值增值主体责任。

headlines.title_en: Local pension fund investment return rate in 2025 was 5.76%
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 1 - The National Council for Social Security Fund (NCSSF) released a report today (1st), stating that in 2025, local pension fund investment returns reached 142.071 billion yuan, with an investment return rate of 5.76%. Since the start of entrusted operations in December 2016, cumulative investment returns from local pension funds have totaled 554.430 billion yuan, with an average annual return rate of 5.14%, exceeding the average annual guaranteed return rate of 2.63% by approximately 2.51 percentage points. The report notes that the NCSSF adheres to and continuously enriches the philosophy of 'long-term investment, value investment, responsible investment,' prudently managing investment operations and faithfully fulfilling its primary responsibility for fund safety and value preservation.

headlines.title: 券商收到通知！交易所行情接入，重要调整！影响多大？
headlines.summary: 据上海航交所，本周，中国出口集装箱运输市场总体平稳，不同航线市场运价走势出现分化，综合指数上涨。据国家统计局公布的数据显示，中国7月制造业PMI降至49.2，景气水平环比有所回落，但装备制造业和高技术制造业PMI分别为51.4和53.3，保持较快扩张，带动制造业发展向新向优。7月31日，上海航运交易研究所发布的上海出口集装箱综合运价指数为3205.97点，较上期上涨4.7%。

headlines.summary: 周五（7月31日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨6.15个基点，报4.7347%，本周累计上涨5.76个基点，7月份累计上涨25.56个基点，整体持续震荡上行，交投于4.4534%-4.7450%区间，北京时间8月1日01:47逼近2025年1月14日顶部4.8069%、2023年10月23日顶部5.0187%。 两年期美债收益率涨4.53个基点，报4.2912%，临近结束交易时短线从4.26%附近拉升至4.29%上方，本周累跌3.94个基点、绝大部分时间处于下跌状态，7月份累涨11.68个基点，交投于4.1018%-4.3683%区间。

headlines.title_en: US 10-year Treasury yield hits highest since January last year, up over 25 basis points in July
headlines.summary_en: Friday (July 31) New York close: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose 6.15 basis points to 4.7347%, up 5.76 basis points for the week and 25.56 basis points for July, trading in a volatile uptrend within a 4.4534%-4.7450% range, approaching the January 14, 2025 high of 4.8069% and the October 23, 2023 high of 5.0187% at 01:47 Beijing time on August 1. Two-year Treasury yield rose 4.53 basis points to 4.2912%, briefly climbing from around 4.26% to above 4.29% late in trading, down 3.94 basis points for the week with most of the time in decline, up 11.68 basis points for July, trading within a 4.1018%-4.3683% range.

headlines.title: 37只配置型基金待发，满足求稳资金需求
headlines.summary: 随着市场波动加剧，追求稳健收益的资金不断涌向配置型产品。数据显示，今年7月成立的FOF、二级债基数量达近百只，在新成立基金中占比近七成，多只产品首募规模超过20亿元。这种热度还在延续，8月这类配置型产品的待发行数量达到37只，部分基金公司正在批量上新。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: 37 allocation-type funds pending launch to meet demand for stable funds
headlines.summary_en: As market volatility intensifies, funds seeking stable returns are flowing toward allocation-type products. Data shows that in July, nearly 100 FOF and secondary bond funds were launched, accounting for nearly 70% of new funds, with multiple products raising over 2 billion yuan in initial offerings. This momentum continues into August, with 37 such allocation-type products slated for issuance, and some fund companies are launching them in batches. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary_en: Looking at the full month's performance, the A-share market showed a pattern of 'dividends outperforming, tech correcting.' Among Shenwan's 31 first-tier industries, coal led with a 14.29% monthly gain, followed by oil and petrochemicals, banks, food and beverages, beauty care, agriculture and forestry, transportation, retail, home appliances, and pharmaceuticals; tech sectors like electronics and communications, which had previously risen sharply, saw corrections.
